title: partner-cloud-marketplace-weekly-prep-jamie-2026-04-13
content:
Weekly partner marketplace sync prep (jamie) - 2026-04-13

Attendees (expected): AWS BD: Laura, Sam; Azure GTM: Ravi; GCP Partnerships: Mei; Redwood: Jamie, Alex, Priya
Timebox: 30 mins
Location: Zoom + record

Goals for this meeting:
- Quick alignment on pipeline and co-sell opportunities (top 3)
- Confirm upcoming marketplace promotions (AWS promo week / Azure co-sell window)
- Decide on rollout plan for new dedicated offering listing (private deploy + KMS notes)
- Identify blockers and action owners

Agenda (tight):
1) 5m - Quick wins / wins since last sync (round-robin)
   - bring 2 bullets max each: new customer, approved marketplace listing, promotional credit used
2) 10m - GTM & Marketplace updates per cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP)
   - AWS: status of promo assets, PR timeline, listing page QA, cost/pricing approval (Sam to confirm)
   - Azure: co-sell readiness checklist, Partner Center listing pending security review (Ravi)
   - GCP: pilot customers interested in private deployment, technical FAQ outstanding (Mei)
3) 10m - Technical/ops blockers & support needs
   - billing metering format mismatch (need example invoices)
   - KMS/HSM integration doc for private deploy (action: Priya to share draft)
   - Marketplace test accounts: who has admin access? (Jamie to verify)
4) 5m - Wrap: commit action items, next sync cadence

Quick data to call out (prep numbers):
- Marketplace leads (last 30d): AWS 14, Azure 9, GCP 7
- Converts from leads -> trial: 45% (AWS highest)
- Estimated monthly committed spend from pipeline: ~$120k (breakdown: AWS $70k, Azure $30k, GCP $20k)
- Known blockers: listing QA backlog (3 items), legal SSLA questions (1 open)

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize Redwood Dedicated listing: highlight SLA, isolation, KMS + audit logs; anticipate 2 questions: pricing bands and onboarding time
- For AWS promo: ask for a specific PR date and if they can share co-marketing funds; remind them of deadline for artwork (next Wed)
- For Azure co-sell: ask for primary AM contact and any pre-reqs for co-sell registration
- For GCP: push for pilot funding; ask for success criteria for pilot (metrics we should measure: latency, cost per token, uptime percent)

Open questions to surface:
- Who will keep marketplace listing copy in-sync with product docs? (ops vs. product comms)
- Do we need separate SKUs for Dedicated vs Hosted in listings? (pricing/legal implications)
- Any region restrictions we must call out for private deploy images? (APAC limitations?)

Prep deliverables to drop into meeting doc before sync:
- One-pager: marketplace listing differences (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) - Alex to finalize by EOD 4/12
- Draft KMS/HSM integration FAQ - Priya to attach
- Sample invoice + metering spec - Jamie to pull from finance

Follow-ups (post-meeting) - draft messaging:
- Template email to partner AMs summarizing agreed PR dates + assets needed
- Internal ticket to product-ops for SKU guidance and legal to confirm SSLA language

Tone / ask guidance for each cloud rep:
- AWS: be direct on exact PR date, escalation path if listing rejected; ask for comms lead for co-marketing
- Azure: be collaborative — offer to run co-sell readiness workshop if helpful
- GCP: push for measurable pilot agreement (define 3 success metrics)

Rough script for opening 60s:
"Thanks everyone — quick run through wins, then a focused ask list for each cloud so we can lock PR dates and asset owners. We have ~30 minutes so if something needs deeper dive we'll spin up a follow-up with the right folks."

Misc shorthand notes (to clean up later):
- AWS promo week => need AWS legal ok on credit terms
- JIRA PLAT-1024 => marketplace metering format (blocking invoices test)
- Get list of SKUs from finance team before next Wed

Potential risks to call out if asked:
- Delay in listing QA will push promo out 2-3 weeks -> impacts pipeline timing
- If KMS integration notes not published, enterprise buyers may stall procurement for private deploys

End of prep notes. Keep this doc as the meeting capture skeleton and paste action items into JIRA after sync.
action_items: Alex: finalize one-pager (marketplace listing differences) by 2026-04-12
Priya: attach draft KMS/HSM integration FAQ before sync
Jamie: pull sample invoice + metering spec from finance and share in meeting doc
Sam (AWS): confirm PR/publish date for AWS promo or escalate to AM by 2026-04-14
Ravi (Azure): confirm co-sell readiness checklist items and primary AM contact
Mei (GCP): provide pilot funding decision + define 3 success metrics
Product-Ops: advise on SKU strategy for Dedicated vs Hosted (ticket created: JIRA-PLAT-1024)
